title: Greenwood Lake Marina
gap: Prices for dock space, boat club membership, and services not stated
blurb: Greenwood Lake Marina offers over 200 wet slips for boats 10-25 feet, boat sales including new and used Starcraft and Avalon Pontoon Boats, full-service repairs with certified technicians, winterizing and storage options, and a boat club with access to a fleet for a fixed monthly fee. Amenities include picnic areas, charcoal grills, restrooms, showers, dressing areas, and a large deck overlooking the lake.
